mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the signal fails to generate a negative return direction in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand momentum, which drives corporate earnings expectations and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 over two consecutive months signals weakening supply-side activity, which reduces corporate output and profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal shows no statistical significance (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 230.0 over the past month signals accelerating inflation, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.0, or the signal fails to show a negative directional bias (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising GDP (GDPC1) and stable or declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong, sustainable economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and stable UNRATE fails to generate positive 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 133,000 in a single month signals strong labor market demand, which increases consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline returns in 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 96.0 combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% indicates a supply-demand mismatch, signaling economic contraction and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining INDPRO and rising UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
